facts.claim: Vlrardja removed to his palace at Nalkandd at the start of the war.
facts.quote: Vlrardja, at the commencement of the war, had removed to his palace at Nalkandd, a place almost inaccessible to an army.

facts.claim: He took his women, band, treasures and remaining Coorg families with him.
facts.quote: He had taken with him his women, his band, his treasures and what remained of the Coorg Bdjah's families, that he might destroy them all, if necessary,

facts.claim: He prohibited his Coorgs from confronting Company troops to allow easy advance.
facts.quote: he sent orders, prohibiting his Coorgs from encountering the troops of the Company, hence the easy advance of the latter.
